evals.prompt: Record the two synthetic revenue extracts. Keep the original accepted figure visible and show the later conflicting value as pending. Outstanding debt is missing; retain that gap. Return cited records and a readable review table.
evals.expected_output: Source hashes and line locators, unchanged accepted claim, pending conflicting claim, null debt claim with an explicit reason, no source-truth assertion.
assertions: The original claim remains available with its acceptance reference.
No missing value or confidence score is invented.
The reported conflict includes the exact claim IDs and contexts.

evals.prompt: A revised claim uses thousands while the previous claim uses millions for the same entity, metric and period. Stage the update and explain what needs review without choosing a winner.
evals.expected_output: A value/context conflict with both declared units preserved; no automatic conversion, acceptance or overwrite.
assertions: Unit differences are surfaced without conversion.
Source labels or recency do not automatically determine which value is accepted.

evals.prompt: Apply a reviewed proposal after the base ledger has been edited. Preserve the files and explain the refusal.
evals.expected_output: A stale-base rejection, unchanged base and no new applied ledger; a fresh proposal is required.
assertions: The earlier accepted claim and prior files remain intact.
